title: Pet Shop Picture Song
hook: If the lifelong needs do not fit, walking away is good care too.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D pet-shop storybook, organized shelves and animal enclosures, no readable labels, clean subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child participating in an adult-led responsible pet decision
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written readiness criteria; supplies do not imply purchase
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: readiness cue -> recall beat -> target -> checklist/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a light woodblock browse-click and marimba confirmation after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a light woodblock browse-click and marimba confirmation after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Pet Shop Picture Song into a responsible decision sequence: learn the species, calculate long-term habitat/cost/time, prepare the home, choose ethical source/adoption route, then commit—supplies are not permission for impulse buying.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child and adult walk past picture cards and supply shelves asking whether the household can meet lifelong needs before any animal comes home.
